operator_reality.source: Current HEAD is ceda515a275d5ccfc0675e999ad2aa9307a70264 at package version 0.2.175, but SeoView.tsx and docs/feature-tests.md are modified. HEAD equality alone does not prove the artifact contains those working-tree edits.

blocking.finding: The importer trusts only the artifact's own provenance and caller-supplied SHA/run identity. Both can agree without establishing that the downloaded bytes came from that successful main-push CI run.
blocking.fix: Bind the import to GitHub's run/artifact metadata: verify repository, workflow, push event, main ref, successful conclusion, head SHA, run ID/attempt, artifact identity and GitHub artifact digest (or download the exact artifact by ID through gh and verify that metadata). Keep the CI receipt and tree hash as separate byte-integrity checks.

blocking.finding: Local HEAD equality alone can label a historical or dirty checkout as 'current source'; the checkout is dirty now. A native pass could be attributed to edits absent from the downloaded CI build.
blocking.fix: At import and native-result recording, compare the source SHA to freshly fetched origin/main and distinguish clean tracked checkout from local modifications. If dirty or main advanced, label the artifact as exact pushed commit only, not current working source, and leave changed-source acceptance pending until those edits are pushed and a matching CI artifact exists.

blocking.finding: recordLocalDevBuild admits only .output/chrome-mv3[-dev] and writes receipts only directly under test-results. The plan broadens the build directory but does not specify the receipt output-path contract needed for a run-qualified import subtree.
blocking.fix: Specify a single strict run-qualified test-results layout and extend both path admission checks to that layout; keep existing .output admission, exclusive receipt creation, symlink refusal, and hash verification. Keep CI receipt/provenance outside the hashed unpacked tree.

advisory: Validate the effective bundled WXT configuration from the explicit CI environment and the approved https://db.matrxserver.com origin; checking variable shapes before a build does not by itself prove those values were embedded.
The workflow's main-ref concurrency cancels superseded runs; an imported artifact from a cancelled or older run must retain its exact-commit label.
